summary_en: TOTO initiated a share buyback program authorizing acquisition of up to 9.5 million shares (5.8% of outstanding shares) for a maximum of 30 billion yen through market purchases from November 1, 2026 to March 31, 2027, with subsequent cancellation of all acquired shares except 100,000 shares scheduled for April 30, 2027.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On October 30, 2026, TOTO's Board of Directors authorized a treasury stock acquisition program under Article 459 of the Companies Act. The company will acquire up to 9.5 million shares (5.8% of outstanding shares excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of 30 billion yen through market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange between November 1, 2026 and March 31, 2027. The outstanding share count as of September 30, 2026 was 164,454,537 shares (excluding 1,903,860 treasury shares).

Following completion of the acquisition, TOTO will cancel all acquired shares except 100,000 shares on April 30, 2027. The company stated the program is designed to improve capital efficiency and enable flexible capital allocation in response to changing business conditions, consistent with its medium-term management agenda WILL2030. The specific cancellation date will be announced once the acquisition is completed and the cancellation date is formally determined.
